verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs explicitly support adding one-off bonuses to payroll and running payroll 'as often as you need' on a flexible schedule, plus one-off/recurring pay type customization, which together describe off-cycle payroll capability for bonuses. However, there is no explicit documentation covering off-cycle runs specifically for corrections or terminations, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit mention of termination or correction off-cycle runs, and third-party verification of the off-cycle payroll process.
